Context: 2. Disciplinary Proceedings

3. Initiation of Departmental Proceedings.Whenever a disciplinary case file is submitted to the Disciplinary Authority, seeking the approval of the Disciplinary Authority for initiation of departmental proceedings against a Government servant, a draft of the articles of charge, complete in all respects, along with the imputations in support and the list of witnesses and documents, should be submitted to the Disciplinary Authority for its consideration.
